svg.text: FAIL-SAFE FUSION DECISION MATRIX & MODAL DEGRADATION LOGIC
Dynamic Hand-Off Guarantees System Robustness Without Hallucinating Confidence When Both Modalities Suffer

g.text: STATE 1: NOMINAL DUAL-STREAM OPERATION
Camera HEALTHY (R ≥ 0.70) • LiDAR HEALTHY (R ≥ 0.70)
• Both modalities exhibit high visual sharpness and dense 3D geometry.
• Evidential fusion combines mutual confidence masses.
• Fused weights maintain balanced distribution:
w_cam ≈ 0.50, w_lidar ≈ 0.50 → F1: 0.9852, Loc Error: 0.0137 m
STATE 2: CAMERA MOTION BLUR / TUNNEL BLACKOUT
Camera FAILED (R < 0.15) • LiDAR HEALTHY (R ≥ 0.70)
• Severe visual degradation detected via Laplacian variance / luminance.
• Hysteresis smoothly collapses camera weight toward minimum threshold.
• LiDAR retains full responsibility without perception interruption:
w_lidar → 0.99, w_cam → 0.01 → F1 Remains: 0.9853 (Clean Pass)
STATE 3: LiDAR 85% DROPOUT & BACKSCATTER SPRAY
Camera HEALTHY (R ≥ 0.70) • LiDAR SEV_DEGRADED (0.15 ≤ R < 0.40)
• Rain/fog pulse attenuation collapses cluster return density below 1/d curve.
• Adaptive density gating suppresses noisy sparse cluster candidates.
• Camera semantics preserve obstacle localization:
Precision: 0.4000 (vs 0.0241 Fixed Late Fusion — 16.6x Cleaner)
STATE 4: DUAL SENSOR SEVERE FAILURE (FAIL-SAFE)
Camera FAILED (R < 0.15) • LiDAR FAILED (R < 0.15)
• Both visual stream and point cloud are critically compromised.
• System DOES NOT hallucinate false confidence (Fixed fusion falsely outputs 0.2338).
• Automatically depresses fused confidence to signal vehicle safety stop:
Fused Confidence: 0.0673 – 0.0773 → SAFETY INTERVENTION TRIGGERED
